spans.s: भृग् ind. An imitative word expressive of the crackling sound of fire.

भृगु m. 1. Name of a Ṛshi regarded as the ancestor of the Bhṛgus (at M.i.35); he is described as one of the primeval patriarchs created by the first Manu; 2. a name of the sage Jamadagni; 3. an epithet of Śukra; 4. of Kṛṣṇa; 5. the planet Venus; 6. a cliff, a precipice, भृगुपतनमकार्षीत् D.K.; 7. the level summit of a mountain.
भृगु-उद्वह m. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
भृगु-ज, -तनय m. an epithet of Śukra.
भृगु-ज, -तनय m. an epithet of Śukra.
भृगु-नंदन m. 1. an epithet of Paraśurāma; 2. of Śukra.
भृगु-पति m. an epithet of Paraśurāma, भृगुपतियशोवर्त्मं यत्क्रौंचरंध्रम् Megh.i.57.
भृगूणांपति m. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
भृगु-वंश m. name of a family deriving their origin from Paraśurāma.
भृगु-शार्दूल, -श्रेष्ठ, -सत्तम m. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
भृगु-शार्दूल, -श्रेष्ठ, -सत्तम m. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
भृगु-शार्दूल, -श्रेष्ठ, -सत्तम m. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
भृगु-सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Paraśurāma; 2. of Venus.
भृगु-सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Paraśurāma; 2. of Venus.
